## Alkami Technology - Senior Software Engineer – MANTL

🔗 [Apply](https://alkami.wd12.myworkdayjobs.com/alkami/job/us-remote/sr-software-engineer--mantl-_jr-000776-1)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building backend services for Alkami’s digital banking platform for U.S. banks and credit unions. Designing microservices and guiding architecture and code quality.
Senior Software Engineer building backend services for Alkami’s digital banking platform
- Salary: $140,000 - $165,000 per year
- Tech stack: JavaScript, Node.js, Python, React, TypeScript, Go
- Write clean, documented, and well-tested backend code
- Emphasize error-handling, logging, edge cases, long-term viability, and performance
- Break down complex product requirements into elegant solutions
- Design systems and evaluate architectural tradeoffs
- Write, communicate, and advocate for architectural decisions
- Provide technical guidance, suggestions, and code reviews to teammates
- Work on Alkami's digital sales and service platform for U.S. banks and credit unions
- 10+ years professional experience with back end technologies (Node.js, Python, Go, TypeScript etc.)
- Exposure to ReactJS and NestJS
- Well versed with REST APIs
- Experience working in an agile SCRUM environment
- Well versed with domain driven design
- Well versed with Microservice architecture
- Candidates must be eligible to work in the US for full-time employment
- Must write clean, thoroughly documented, and well-tested code

Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building backend services for Alkami’s digital banking platform for U.S. banks and credit unions. Designing microservices and guiding architecture and code quality.
Senior Software Engineer building backend services for Alkami’s digital banking platform
